organization.discoveryNotes: Healthcare operating model: clinic/network readiness, patient service workflows, privacy-aware security, and advisory compliance posture — not an EMR/EHR or clinical decision tool.

workflows.name: Patient service request intake
workflows.description: Front desk or patient services captures a service request with role-based routing — operations coordination only.

workflows.name: Appointment request coordination
workflows.description: Appointment or visit request is logged and assigned; full audit trail for operator review.

workflows.name: Patient issue escalation
workflows.description: Service issue escalates to operations manager with evidence-ready notes.

workflows.name: Staff schedule / workforce request
workflows.description: Shift or coverage request routed through HR coordinator and clinic manager.

workflows.name: Supplies request
workflows.description: Clinic supplies request with pharmacy/supplies coordinator review.

workflows.name: Supplier purchase request
workflows.description: Procurement approval chain before supplier commitment.

workflows.name: Incident / safety report
workflows.description: Safety incident logged for quality and privacy review — advisory evidence readiness.

workflows.name: Quality review
workflows.description: Quality review of service or process with corrective action tracking.

workflows.name: Privacy access review
workflows.description: Periodic access review for sensitive roles — operator-managed controls.

workflows.name: Billing / finance review
workflows.description: Billing or charge review before month-end close.

workflows.name: Role / access change review
workflows.description: Role change requires IT and CyberCrow review trail.

workflows.name: Monthly healthcare operations report
workflows.description: Operations and readiness metrics for leadership review.

workflows.name: CyberCrow incident review
workflows.description: Security incident triage with evidence trail — advisory operator-managed controls.

securityRequirements.requirement: MFA for privileged admin and manager accounts
Role-based access for patient service and billing roles (advisory)
Audit logging on access changes and escalations
Privacy readiness notes for identity and access (not certification claim)

integrations.notes: SSO for clinic staff; conditional access for admin VLAN (readiness)
Future ERP for finance and medical consumables — not live integration

experienceRequirements.requirement: Operations health, open incidents, privacy posture KPIs (advisory)
Workflow backlog, pending approvals, staffing overview
Task-focused UI; minimal sensitive detail on screen; shift handoff

identity.ssoNotes: Healthcare template: Entra ID + MFA for managers and admins; break-glass procedure documented (operator-managed).

security.complianceNotes: Advisory privacy readiness only — segregate service, billing, and HR datasets in blueprint notes; no live patient medical records in non-production.
